metadata.description: Personal collection of Agent Skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: cloudflare-platform-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture and project organization for complex Cloudflare apps in a pnpm/turbo monorepo — multiple Workers, SPA+API apps, Queues, Workflows, crons, D1/R2 shared across deployables.

plugins.name: comments-cleanup
plugins.description: Sweep a codebase and remove comment noise while preserving the comments that earn their place, honoring the project's own comment policy.

plugins.name: opencodewiki
plugins.description: Generates and maintains a repository wiki that a coding agent reads before planning a change: what each feature does today, and the patterns the codebase already follows. Source-grounded, OKF v0.2, git-native. Requires the opencodewiki CLI (npm i -g opencodewiki).

plugins.name: retrospective
plugins.description: Run an evidence-first retrospective on a solo, agent-assisted project. Collects git, prompt history, CI and plans deterministically, consolidates with subagents, then interviews you against the record — turning the corrections you keep repeating into rules, tools and hooks.
